semantic_rule: No V69 row changes exact identity, formal value, mnemonic, UNKNOWN status or lineage.
V69 adds two local source expansions beside each bound event; it changes no event card value.
Question marks and exact-joint-tuple-only scope remain part of every mnemonic.
Medical display text is an explicitly tagged local edition, never a dictionary update.
Body, bath, patient and apparatus bindings remain image or exemplar content.
Every Astro group remains a page-local exemplar fragment with no imported prose mnemonic.
